style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting (Style D). The first reference image is the plain blue jelly slime; keep its clean dark-blue outline, chunky readable pixels, soft inner glow and two small glossy dark eyes at the upper front right. Any further reference shows this same evolved creature or the pose to use. Side view, facing right. Draw only the creature: no ground, no shadow, no text.

frames.name: gleipnir
frames.prompt: A stage-four evolved slime called Gleipnir, drawn as one creature in side view facing right: the same translucent jelly body, now a deep dark indigo blue, bound in a single slender shimmering ribbon of silver silk with a pale blue-white sheen that wraps around the body in several tight loops and is tied in a neat bow-knot at the top of its back, the two loose ribbon ends fluttering behind it, a few tiny pale glints along the ribbon, a soft dark-blue inner glow. Two small glossy dark eyes at the upper front right. Pose and shape: the creature resting, a rounded dome slightly wider than tall. Use only blue, indigo, silver and white tones: no pink, magenta or pink-violet colours or highlights anywhere on the creature.
